notes: Portuguese read by an English speaker. The transparent pairs are Latinate vocabulary shared through both languages' borrowing (informação/information, possível/possible) plus outright loans. Nasal vowels and the lh/nh digraphs are folded; the rest is edit distance. Threshold 0.70. Cutoff: Above 0.75 is shared Latinate vocabulary a reader cannot miss: base, canal, alternativa/alternative, apartamento/apartment, artista/artist. The band below holds acredita/accredit, which is not what acreditar means.
